title: .khipu package format
description: Safe model package binding graph, weights, ABI, quantization, hashes and signatures. Inherits the four correctness fixes at birth: byte digests over weight files, real RFC 8785 JCS manifest digest, honest *.unsigned.json naming when signatures is empty, specVersion never hardcoded elsewhere.

specVersion.description: Package spec version string. NOT hardcoded anywhere else; the package file is the single source of truth.

graph.description: Computation graph (KIDS program plus tensor metadata).

sha256.description: Digest of the actual weight FILE BYTES (chunked sha256_file), never of a name or label.

manifestJcsSha256.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization of the manifest. Real JCS, not json.dumps(sort_keys=True).

signatures.description: Signature wrappers. EMPTY ARRAY IS ALLOWED and means unsigned: the file MUST then be named *.unsigned.json. An empty signatures array is never 'signed'.
